samples.question: Start at the red ring and follow the one connected dark thread to the gold triangle. Ignore the pale background dots. Read its eighteen cyan beads in travel order. Pair first with last, second with next-to-last, and so on. Replace each pair by the exact midpoint of its bead centers and connect the nine midpoints in first-half order. Ignoring only position, rotation, and uniform size, which path is closest: chevron, zigzag, or hook? Chevron means four equal diagonal steps to one tip then four away; zigzag means eight advancing diagonal steps alternating sides; hook means six equal straight steps then two equal right-angle steps. Answer ambiguous only if the two closest paths tie.
